resources.string: Measure for about 30 seconds under stable reference conditions. For a dark reference, cover the optical inputs with material opaque to near-infrared too and keep the LEDs in their normal operating state. Under illumination, the reference light is also subtracted, giving relative measurements. This procedure does not calibrate gain.
For UVC, UVB and UVA, the mean reading of each channel is proposed. UV gain adjusts automatically to the light level.
For each visible/infrared channel, the mean reading is proposed.
Proposal from %1$s readings. No settings have been changed.
Measurement interrupted or unavailable. Check the connection and sensor, then try again.
Reset correction factors to 1 and offsets to 0 for %1$s. Other calibration and optical-window settings are unchanged.
Resets the general multiplier and all optical-window channel multipliers to 1. Calibration is unchanged.
